about: The chronicler continues reading Moses' rod as the cross: the water turned to blood, the darkness, the rod that changes between dry and living, and the stretched hand. He then reads the battle with Amalek (Exodus 17) as the war of believers against demons, with Aaron and Hur as the two thieves, the bitter water of Marah as sweetened by the sign of the cross, and ends with David's prophecies of the nailing and the vinegar.

sentences.i: And the rod of Moses too, through which he worked wonders, is interpreted as the wood of the cross, by which Adam and his children were saved from the torment of the demons;
sentences.n: Read this as the start of the typological argument: each act of Moses' rod is matched by an act of Christ's cross. ወበትረ is ወ- 'and' + በትር 'rod' in the construct state (before ሙሴ); -ኒ on ሙሴኒ is the emphatic 'also'. እንተ ባቲ is the feminine relative 'which' (agreeing with በትር, a feminine noun) + በ- with -ቲ 'her', 'in which, through which'; በዘገብረ is በ- + ዘ- 'what' + ገብረ 'he did'. ትተረጐም 'she/it is interpreted' (3fs imperfect, passive, agreeing with the rod); the ዕፀ መስቀል 'wood of the cross' is what it is read as. በዘአድኀኖ 'by that by which he saved him' is a loose relative: the subject, Christ, is only understood. ወለደቂቁ is ወ- + ለ- (marking the object) + 'his sons'; እምሥቃየ 'from the torment of' (እም- + construct). This part begins mid-paragraph of the chapter (continuing ch. 98 part 1), so unit 0 has no paragraph mark.

sentences.l: And-as Moses struck with-her the-water-of Tekezé and-made-it blood and-killed fish-their, likewise Christ-also by-his-cross killed death and-brought-them-out from-within Sheol;
sentences.i: And as Moses struck the water of the Tekezé with it and made it blood and killed their fish, so Christ also by his cross killed death and brought them out of Sheol;
sentences.n: ወበከመ 'and as' (ወ- + በ- + ከመ) opens the 'as ... so' comparison that runs through the part; ከማሁ 'likewise' answers it, and -ኒ again means 'also'. ዘበጠ 'he struck'. ተከዜ is the Tekezé, the great Ethiopian river; the chronicler sets the Nile plague (Exodus 7:20-21) on his own country's river. ወረሰያ 'and he made it' (ረሰየ, 3ms perfect + -ኣ 'it', the rod's water taken as feminine or collective). ዓሣቲሆሙ 'their fish' (plural ዓሣት + -ሆሙ). ቀተሎ ለሞት 'killed death' (ቀተለ 'killed' + -ኦ, doubled by ለ- marking the object), and ሲኦል is Sheol, the underworld the dead were held in.

sentences.l: And-as(?) Moses struck with-his-rod into winds and-was-dark all land-of Egypt until 3 day and-3 night, darkness which one-gropes (?) until not-they-rose from-beds-their, and-likewise Christ-also, hanged upon wood, lit darkness-of hearts-of man, and-rose from-the-dead on-third day and-third night;
sentences.i: And as Moses struck with his rod into the winds, and all the land of Egypt grew dark for three days and three nights, a darkness in which one gropes (?), so that they did not rise from their beds, so Christ also, hanged upon the wood, lit the darkness of human hearts, and rose from the dead on the third day and the third night;
sentences.n: Source slip kept as printed: ወበከ ፡ መ ፡ ሙሴ, where the printer split ወበከመ 'and as' into three words; read it as ወበከመ. Plague of darkness, Exodus 10:21-23. ዘበጠ በበትሩ 'who struck with his rod' (the second በ- is 'with, by means of'); ውስተ ነፋሳት 'into the winds', ነፋሳት plural of ነፋስ. ወጸልመ 'and it grew dark' (ጸልመ, 3ms perfect); ኵላ ምድረ ግብጽ 'all the land of Egypt' (ኵላ accusative, ምድረ construct). The numerals: ፫ ፡ ዕለት 'three days', ወ፫ ፡ ሌሊት 'and three nights', the noun singular after a number. ዘያርመሰምስ is a relative + a four-letter verb, 3ms imperfect (the type of አንጐርጐረ, with the prefix ya-), said of the darkness; I take the subject as indefinite, 'one gropes (in it)', which is my reading from the form (?); Exodus 10:21 is the passage alluded to. እስከ ኢይትነሥኡ 'until they did not rise', here 'so that'. ተሰቂሎ 'having been hanged' (ተሰቅለ, converb), አብርህ 'he lit' (3ms perfect, causative of በርሀ); ጽልመተ አልባበ ሰብእ is a construct chain. በሣልስት ዕለት 'on the third day' (ordinal ሣልስ + fem. -ት).

sentences.i: And as the rod of Moses underwent a turning and a changing at the word of God, so that, being dry, it became living (?), and again, being living, it became dry; so Christ also, by the wood of his cross, made life for the Christian people, for those who have believed in him;
sentences.n: The rod that became a serpent and then a rod again (Exodus 4:3-4; 7:10-12). በትረ ሙሴ 'rod of Moses' (construct); ኮነ ሚጦተ ወወልጦተ 'became a turning and a changing' (two verbal nouns in the accusative, ሚጦት and ወልጦት; ኮነ is 3ms though the rod is fem., then ኮነት 3fs). በቃለ 'at the word of' (በ- + construct). The pair ይብስት / ዘነፍስ is my reading: ይብስት 'dry' (feminine, agreeing with the rod; ይብስ is the printed spelling of የብስ 'dry', as in the known entry for እንተ የብስ) (?) against ዘነፍስ 'that of soul', i.e. living, ነፍስ 'soul, life'; I take እንዘ ይብስት ... ዘነፍስ as 'while dry ... living' (?). በዕፀ መስቀሉ 'by the wood of his cross'; ለሕዝበ ክርስቲያን 'for the Christian people' (ለ- + construct); ለእለ አምኑ ቦቱ 'for those who believed in him' (እለ 'those who', አምኑ 3mp perfect, ቦቱ = በ + 'him').

sentences.i: He did this by the sign of the cross, so that he might drive out the spirit of the demons, for the demons and the Christians had changed places;
sentences.n: ረሰየ 'he made (it so)', the object left to be understood; በትእምርተ 'by the sign of' (በ- + construct). ከመ ይሰደዲ 'that he might drive out': a purpose clause with a jussive, spelled ይሰደዲ as printed (the regular jussive would be ይሰድድ, so the form may be corrupt or a variant (?)). መንፈሰ አጋንንት 'spirit of demons' (construct). እስመ 'for, because'. ተውላጠ ኮኑ 'they became exchanged' (ተውላጠ a participle or noun 'changed, exchanged' + ኮኑ 3mp perfect of ኮነ); the exchange is explained in the next unit: the demons, once spirits, fell; Christians, who were not, become spiritual.

sentences.i: They, although they were spiritual beings, became deficient by transgressing the command of their Lord, and became exiles (?) through the power of his cross; and we also have become spiritual, by receiving his body and blood in place of those spiritual beings who were driven out, and we have become praisers (?), we who believe in his cross and in his holy resurrection;
sentences.n: This explains the exchange of the previous unit: the fallen spirits (demons) lost their place; believers take it. እሙንቱ 'they' (3mp pronoun); እንዘ መንፈሳዊያን 'while spiritual ones'; ኮኑ ኅሱራነ 'they became deficient' (accusative plural of ኅሱር, predicate); በተዐድዎ ትእዛዘ 'by transgressing the commandment of' (በ- + verbal noun + construct); እግዚኦሙ 'their Lord' (እግዚእ + -ሙ). ስዲዳነ 'driven out, exiled' (accusative plural of the adjective ስዲድ, of the same type as ኅሱር and passive in sense, not a participle; a reading from the context (?)). The verb ኮነ is printed in the 3ms form with plural subjects in ወንሕነኒ ኮነ መንፈሳዊያነ 'and we also became spiritual ones' and ወኮነ ንሕነ ሰባሕያነ 'and we became praisers' (the regular 1cp would be ኮንነ); kept as printed. ሰባሕያነ 'praisers' (?) from a root of praise; I read ሰባሕያን as 'those who give praise, glorifiers'. በነሢአ 'by taking' (infinitive); ህየንቴሆሙ 'in their place'; ለእለ ተሰዲ is printed as is: 'of those who were driven out' (ተሰዲ read as a passive of ሰደደ, 3mp perfect, a short spelling (?)); እለ አመነ 'who believed', singular verb after plural relative, as in earlier parts. ቅድስት 'holy', feminine, agreeing with ትንሣኤ 'resurrection'.

sentences.n: ዘበጠ አድባረ 'who struck mountains' (አድባረ accusative plural of ደብር; the allusion is unclear, perhaps the plagues generally or the rock, so the reading of 'mountains' is as printed (?)); ወአምጽአ መቅሠፍተ 'and he brought a scourge' (ወ- + causative perfect + accusative); በትእዛዘ 'at the command of'. ሰፊሖ is a converb, 'having stretched / stretching' (ሰፍሐ), twice: first of Moses, then of Christ, the stretched hand being the link between the two. ለአጋንንት is ለ- marking the object; እምላዕለ 'from upon' (እም- + ላዕለ).

sentences.i: When God said to Moses, 'Strike with your rod,' this means: 'Mark with the seal of Christ's cross,' that is to say;
sentences.n: ብሂል 'saying, that is' is the interpreter's formula that closes each reading; here it brackets the interpretation. The sentence has no main verb (the next unit opens a parallel ወሶበ 'and when' clause in the same way; it does not resume this one). ዝብጥ 'strike!' (imperative, 2ms, of ዘበጠ; spelled with ብ as printed); ዕትብ 'seal! mark!' (imperative of ዐተበ); ማዕተበ 'seal of' (construct); ለክርስቶስ 'of Christ' (ለ- marking the possessor after the anticipatory suffix on መስቀሉ 'his cross'). So striking is read as signing with the cross.

sentences.i: And when God said to Moses, 'Stretch out your hand,' this too means that by the stretching out of his hand Christ saved us from servitude to the enemy (?) and gave us his own life, by the stretching out of his hand upon the wood of the cross.
sentences.n: ስፋሕ 'stretch!' (imperative, 2ms of ሰፍሐ); ዝኒ 'this too' (ዝ + -ኒ). The ከመ 'that' clause gives the meaning: በስፍሐተ 'by the stretching of' (በ- + construct); አድኀነነ 'he saved us' (3ms perfect + -ነ); እምተቀንዮ 'from servitude' (?): ተቀንዮ is a noun of the root ቀነየ 'serve, be subject', my reading from the root, supported by ተቀንዮ ወሰብሖ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'service and praise of God' elsewhere in the book, with ለጸላኢ 'to the enemy' (ለ- 'to', ጸላኢ 'enemy') (?). ወወሀበነ 'and he gave us'; እንቲአሁ 'his own' (fem. relative-possessive agreeing with ሕይወት 'life'). The unit ends with ። (a full stop inside the chapter's single long paragraph).

sentences.n: Exodus 17:8-13. ወአመኒ ይጸብኡ: ወ- 'and' + አመ 'at the time of' + -ኒ, with the plural verb ይጸብኡ 'they fight' (3mp imperfect) although ዐማልቅ is singular in form, a collective. The last clause is uncertain (?): እስከ ይረክቡ ኀይለ እስራኤል 'until they find the strength of Israel' has a plural verb but no clear subject; it may mean 'until Israel's forces prevail'.

sentences.i: And he says in the Torah that the hands of Moses were steady (?) until the setting of the sun, but nevertheless the hands of Moses were heavy; and whenever it wearied him (?) and he let his hand down from where he had stretched it, Israel were routed (?) and their enemies conquered them;
sentences.n: The chronicler summarises Exodus 17:11-12 loosely ('in the Torah'). ወይቤ 'and he said / says' (3ms perfect ይቤ; the subject is the Scripture's author); ኮና 'they were' (3fp perfect; Geʿez has no dual; the plural verb agrees with the hands in sense, although እዴሁ is singular in form, cf. እደዊሁ in the next clause) with ርቡባተ 'steady, light, soft (?)' (adjective, plural fem.), meaning uncertain (?). ዕርበተ ፀሐይ 'the setting of the sun'; አላ ባሕቱ 'but nevertheless'; ክቡዳት 'heavy' (plural fem.). ሶበ የዐፅቦ 'when it wearies him' (የዐፅቦ 3ms imperfect + -ኦ; the root is ዐጽበ, 'be burdensome, trouble', as in የዐጽበኒ 'it troubles me' elsewhere in the book (?)); ይትዌጽዑ 'are routed, overcome' (?) a reading from the passive stem ተ-; ይመውእዎሙ 'they conquer them' (ሞአ 'conquer'), ፀሮሙ 'their enemies' (ፀር + -ሙ, subject).

sentences.i: And when Aaron and Hur saw this, they set up a stone on Moses' right and on his left, and they laid (?) the hands of Moses upon the stones that Aaron and Hur had set up, Aaron's on the right and Hur's on the left, and they held him on their shoulders, so that he would not bring his hand back from what he had stretched out.
sentences.n: Exodus 17:12: in the Bible Aaron and Hur hold up Moses' hands and a stone is put under him to sit on; here the stones carry the hands. ሶበ ርእዩ 'when they saw' (3mp perfect); ነደቁ 'they set up' (3mp perfect, ነደቀ 'set up, plant'); እብነ 'a stone' (accusative); በየማኑ ወበፀጋሙ 'at his right and at his left' (-ኑ and -ሙ are the suffix -ሁ 'his' contracted after the final consonants ን and ም). ወአፅግዑ 'and they set down, rested (?)' (causative stem; the exact verb is uncertain (?); it may be a slip for ወአጽንዑ 'and they propped, supported' (አጽንዐ), ን and ግ being close in the script (?)); እደወ 'hands of' (a construct plural, as printed). እንተ የማኑ 'that of his right' is the fem. relative standing for 'the one on his right'. ወአኀዝዎ 'and they held him / it' (አኀዘ 'hold', + -ዎ); መታክፍቲሆሙ 'their shoulders'. ከመ ኢያግብእ 'that he not bring back' (jussive negative). እምዘሰፍሖ 'from what he had stretched' (እም- + ዘ- + ሰፍሐ + -ኦ). The unit ends at ።, where the chronicler turns to his own interpretation.

sentences.i: As for the war of Amalek against Israel, it was the war of believers against demons, and before Christ was crucified they conquered the ancients;
sentences.n: The allegory is stated plainly: Amalek is the demons, Israel the believers. ፀብአ 'war of' (construct); -ሰ on ዐማሌቅሰ is 'as for, but'; ውእቱ 'it was' (copula). ወዘእንበለ ይሰቀል 'and before he was crucified' (ዘእንበለ + 3ms imperfect passive subjunctive). ሞእዎሙ is kept as printed (3mp perfect of ሞአ 'conquer' + -ሙ 'them', with the ሞእ- spelling of the stem); the subject is the demons and the object is ለቀደምት 'the ancients, those of old' (ለ- marking the object), so the sense is that the demons overcame the people of old before the cross.

sentences.i: And when he stretched out his hand on the wood of the cross for the sin of Adam and his children, and when he stretched out his hand and was nailed, እራኁ (?), those who are sealed by the cross of Christ conquered them;
sentences.n: Here the picture reverses: after the cross, it is the believers who conquer the demons. ሞእዎሙ is 'they conquered them' with subject እለ ይትዐተቡ 'those who are sealed' (ይትዐተቡ 3mp imperfect, passive/reflexive of ዐተበ 'mark, seal', the sign of the cross); the same ሞእዎሙ is used in the previous unit with the demons as subject. ኀጢአተ አዳም is a construct chain. ተቀነወ 'was nailed, pierced' (ተቀነወ 3ms perfect, passive of ቀነወ 'nail'; the nouns are ቅንዋት 'nails'). እራኁ is unresolved (?): I do not know the word; it follows the verb as if it were an accusative of the part nailed (his … 'hand, side, feet'), but the form is not known to me. It is shown untranslated in `l` and `i`.

sentences.l: Spirit-of life which-he-breathed upon-him, upon-Adam, he-drank vinegar, and-the-hand which founded(?)-it the-earth was-nailed; he-who for-his-sake, for-Adam, having-humbled-himself was-born, likeness(?)-of servant having-taken.
sentences.i: He who breathed the spirit of life upon Adam drank vinegar, and the hand that founded the earth (?) was nailed; he who for Adam's sake humbled himself was born, having taken the likeness (?) of a servant.
sentences.n: The chapter and the part end here, with the closing ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ marks of the part (the five marks belong to this unit). መንፈሰ ሕይወት ዘነፍሐ ላዕሌሁ ለአዳም is fronted: 'the spirit of life which he breathed upon him, upon Adam' (Genesis 2:7), resumed by the subject of ሰረበ 'he drank'. ወእድ እንተ ሣረረታ ለምድር 'and the hand which founded the earth' (እንተ fem. relative; ሣረረታ 'founded it' is a form of a verb ሠረረ read as 'laid the foundation', lemma uncertain (?)); ተቀነወት 'was nailed' (3fs perfect, agreeing with እድ). ዘበእንቲአሁ ለአዳም 'who for his sake, for Adam' (the suffix on በእንቲአ- anticipated by ለአዳም); ተትሒቶ 'having humbled himself' (converb of ተትሕተ); አያያተ ገብር 'the likeness / form of a servant' (the thought is that of Philippians 2:7, but the Geʿez word አያያት I cannot confirm (?)); ነሢኦ 'having taken' (converb of ነሥአ).

glossary.ላዕሌሁ: ላዕለ — upon, over (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form ላዕሌ-) · 'against' (ወቀንኡ ላዕሌሁ 'and they envied him', lit. 'against him', ch. 95) (?)
glossary.መ: ከመ — [mä], the last syllable of በከመ 'according as', printed as a separate word after በከ (source slip)
glossary.መስቀል: መስቀል — cross (noun; genitive after the construct ዕፀ)
glossary.መንፈሳዊያነ: መንፈሳዊ — spiritual ones (adjective used as noun, accusative plural -ያነ)
glossary.መንፈሳዊያን: መንፈሳዊ — spiritual ones (adjective, plural -ያን, used as noun)
glossary.ሚጦተ: ሚጦት — turning, change (verbal noun, accusative; root uncertain) (?)
glossary.ማየ: ማይ — water (noun; accusative) · construct 'water of' (ማየ ተከዜ 'the water of Tekezé')
glossary.ምድረ: ምድር — earth, land (noun, construct state 'land-of') · accusative 'a land', 'the ground' (ምድረ ነኪረ 'a foreign land'; እከሪ ምድረ 'I dig the ground')
glossary.ሞእዎሙ: ሞአ — they conquered them (3mp perfect, spelled ሞእ-, + -ሙ 'them', 3mp)
glossary.ሠናየ: ሠናይ — good (accusative, adj. as noun) · adjective 'good, fine' agreeing with a noun (ልብሰ ሠናየ 'a fine garment')
glossary.ሣረረታ: ሠረረ — she founded it (3fs perfect, G, written ሣረረ + ት + -ኣ 'it'; lemma uncertain) (?)
glossary.ረሰየ: ረሰየ — set, appoint, make (3ms perfect, G, r-s-y)
glossary.ርቡባተ: ርቡብ — meaning uncertain, perhaps 'steady, light' (?) (adjective, accusative plural fem. ርቡባት, predicate of ኮና) (?)
glossary.ርእዩ: ርእየ — see! (2mp imperative) · they saw (3mp perfect, ሶበ ርእዩ 'when they saw'; ch. 53)
glossary.ሰባሕያነ: ሰባሒ — praisers, glorifiers (?) (agent noun, accusative plural ሰባሕያን; from a root of praise) (?)
glossary.ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
glossary.ሰፍሐ: ሰፍሐ — he stretched out (3ms perfect, G, s-f-ḥ)
glossary.ስቅለቱ: ስቅለት — his crucifixion, hanging (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ስዲዳነ: ስዲድ — driven out, exiled (?) (adjective of the qatīl type with passive sense, accusative plural ስዲዳን, predicate of ኮኑ; from ሰደደ) (?)
glossary.ስፍሐ: ስፍሐት — stretching of (?) (verbal noun, construct state; printed without the ት of ስፍሐተ) (?)
glossary.ቀተሎ: ቀተለ — he killed him (3m sg perfect + -o, q-t-l)
glossary.ቀነዉኒ: ቀነወ — they nailed, pierced me (3mp perfect + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.ቅንዋተ: ቅንዋት — nails of, nailing of (noun, construct state)
glossary.በማዕተበ: ማዕተብ — with the seal of (በ- + noun, construct state)
glossary.በሣልስት: ሣልስ — on the third (በ- + ordinal ሣልስ, fem. ሣልስት, agreeing with ዕለት)
glossary.በሰይጣን: ሰይጣን — as Satan, by Satan (በ- 'as, by means of' + proper name)
glossary.በስፍሐተ: ስፍሐት — by the stretching of (በ- + verbal noun, construct state)
glossary.በቃለ: ቃል — by the word of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በበትሩ: በትር — with his rod (በ- 'with, by means of' + noun + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.በትረ: በትር — rod, staff (construct 'rod of') · also accusative 'rod(s)' after a number (ሠለስተ በትረ 'three rods')
glossary.በትሩ: በትር — his rod (በትር + -ሁ '3ms his', the suffix showing as -u on the final ር)
glossary.በትእምርተ: ትእምርት — by the sign of (በ- + noun, construct state)
glossary.በትእዛዘ: ትእዛዝ — in the command of (በ- 'in' + noun, construct state; ዚአክሙ follows)
glossary.በኀይለ: ኀይል — by the power of (በ- 'by' + noun, construct)
glossary.በነሢአ: ነሥአ — by taking (በ- + infinitive ነሢአ, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.በአጋንንት: ጋኔን — as demons (በ- 'as, by means of' + plural አጋንንት)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
glossary.በዕፀ: ዕፅ — by the wood of (በ- + noun, construct state)
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
glossary.በዘአድኀኖ: አድኀነ — by that by which he saved him (በ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect of አድኀነ, causative of ድኅነ, + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.በዘገብረ: ገብረ — by what he did, because of what he did (በ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.በየማኑ: የማን — at his right hand (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.በፈያታዊ: ፈያታዊ — as a thief, robber (በ- 'as, by means of' + noun)
glossary.ባሕቱ: ባሕቱ — but, however, nevertheless (conjunction; አላ ባሕቱ 'but nevertheless')
glossary.ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
glossary.ተሰቂሎ: ተሰቅለ — having been hanged, hanged (converb, 3ms, passive ተ-stem of ሰቀለ)
glossary.ተሰዲ: ተሰድደ — they were driven out (?) (3mp perfect, passive ተ-stem of ሰደደ; short spelling as printed) (?)
glossary.ተቀነወት: ተቀነወ — she was nailed (3fs perfect, passive of ቀነወ; agreeing with እድ)
glossary.ተኀየሉ: ተኀየለ — they grew strong (3mp perfect, T stem of ኀየለ; collective subject)
glossary.ተከዜ: ተከዜ — Tekezé (proper name, the river; genitive after the construct ማየ)
glossary.ተውላጠ: ተውላጥ — exchanged, an exchange (?) (participle or noun, accusative, predicate of ኮኑ) (?)
glossary.ትተረጐም: ተርጐመ — she/it is interpreted (3fs imperfect, T stem passive; agrees with ባሕር)
glossary.ኀይለ: ኀይል — strength (noun, accusative ኀይለ) · construct 'host of' (ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host of heaven') · 'power' (ትገብሩ ኀይለ ከማየ 'you do power like me') · construct 'power of' (ኀይለ ጸላኢ 'the power of the enemy')
glossary.ኀጢአተ: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, construct state 'sin-of') · accusative object, 'sin' (ያአትት ኀጢአተ 'he takes away sin')
glossary.ኅሱራነ: ኅሱር — lacking, deficient (adjective, accusative plural ኅሱራነ)
glossary.ነደቁ: ነደቀ — they set up, planted (3mp perfect)
glossary.ነጐርጓር: ነጐርጓር — murmur, grumbling (noun; cognate accusative of አንጐርጐሩ)
glossary.ነፍስ: ነፍስ — soul, person, life (noun) · 'living, alive' as predicate (እንዘ ነፍስ ኮነት 'while living it became'; ዘነፍስ 'that of life')
glossary.አልባበ: ልብ — hearts of (plural አልባብ, construct state; አልባበ ሰብእ 'hearts of men')
glossary.አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
glossary.አመነ: አምነ — he believed (3ms perfect of አምነ 'believe, have faith', with በ- 'in'; after plural እለ, an irregular match: distributive, or slip for አመኑ (?))
glossary.አርአየ: አርአየ — he showed (3ms perfect, causative of ርእየ)
glossary.አስተዩኒ: አስተየ — give me to drink! (imperative, causative of ሰትየ, plural form አስተዩ (?), + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.አብርህ: አብርሀ — he lit, made bright (3ms perfect, causative of በርሀ; spelled -ህ as printed)
glossary.አንጐርጐሩ: አንጐርጐረ — they murmured, grumbled (3mp perfect, four-letter verb)
glossary.አውረደ: አውረደ — he brought down (3ms perfect, causative of ወረደ)
glossary.አውፅኦሙ: አውፅአ — he brought them out (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem, w-ṣ-ʾ, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አያያተ: አያያት — likeness, form (?) (noun, accusative, before ገብር 'servant') (?)
glossary.አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
glossary.አድባረ: ደብር — mountains of (plural አድባር of ደብር 'mountain', construct) · accusative 'mountains' in a list (አድባረ ወአውግረ አእባነ ወመሬተ 'mountains and hills (?), stones and earth'); construct reading also possible (?)
glossary.አድኀነነ: አድኀነ — he saved us (3ms perfect, causative of ድኅነ, + -ነ 'us', 1cp)
glossary.ኢኮነኑ: ኮነ — was it not? (ኢ- + 3ms perfect + question particle -ኑ)
glossary.ኢያግብእ: አግብአ — that he not bring back (ኢ- + 3ms jussive, causative of ገብአ)
glossary.ኢይትነሥኡ: ተንሥአ — they did not rise (ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, Gt, subjunctive after እስከ)
glossary.እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return') · in case, perhaps (እመ ይሁበከ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'perhaps God may give you offspring') · mother (እም, accusative, predicate: ወኮነተኪ እመ 'and she became a mother to you')
glossary.እምላዕለ: ላዕለ — from upon, from off (እም- + preposition)
glossary.እምሥቃየ: ሥቃይ — from the torment of (እም- + noun, construct state)
glossary.እምረተ: ምረት — from the bitterness of (እም- + noun, construct state)
glossary.እምስካቢሆሙ: ስካብ — from their beds (?) (እም- + noun + -ሆሙ 'their', 3mp; the noun is read from the context) (?)
glossary.እምተቀንዮ: ተቀንዮ — from servitude (?) (እም- + noun, from the root ቀነየ 'serve, be subject'; reading from the root) (?)
glossary.እምካልኣን: ካልእ — from others, other (እም- + adjective, plural ካልኣን)
glossary.እምዉታን: ምዉት — from the dead (እም- + noun, plural ምዉታን, 'dead ones')
glossary.እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected') · 'from what' (እምዘ ንኤዝዘከ 'from what we command you') · 'since' of time (እምዘ ኀለፉ 'since they passed') · 'in respect of what' (እምዘ ንሰምዕ 'in what we hear')
glossary.እምዘሰፍሖ: ሰፍሐ — from what he had stretched it (እም- + ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'it')
glossary.እራኁ: እራኁ — unresolved (?) (form unknown; follows ተቀነወ as if an accusative of the part nailed, perhaps with -ሁ 'his') (?)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took') · 'in which, through which' before በ- + suffix (እንተ ባቲ 'which in her') · 'the one' in እንተ የማኑ 'that of his right', and before a verb with suffix, 'which founded it' (እንተ ሣረረታ)
glossary.እንቲአሁ: እንተ — his own (fem. relative-possessive, እንቲአ- + -ሁ 'his', agreeing with the feminine ሕይወት)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እዎሙ: ሞአ — [ʾəwomu], the last part of ይመውእዎሙ 'they conquer them', with -ዎሙ 'them' (source slip)
glossary.እደወ: እድ — hands of (noun, plural እደው, construct state; as printed)
glossary.እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)
glossary.እግዚኦሙ: እግዚእ — their Lord (noun + -ሙ 'their', 3mp; suffix form እግዚኦ-)
glossary.ኦሪት: ኦሪት — the Torah, the Law (noun); ሕገ ኦሪት 'law of the Torah'
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
glossary.ክርስቶስኒ: ክርስቶስ — Christ also, Christ indeed (proper name + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)' · 3ms used with a feminine subject, ኮነ ሚጦተ 'became a turning' said of the rod (then ኮነት) (?)
glossary.ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ) · 'if it is' after እመ, the subject the unborn child (ወእመሂ ኮነት ወለተ 'and if it is a daughter') · 'was' of place (ማኅደሩ ለእግዚኣብሔር ኮነት ህየ 'God's dwelling was there', ch. 95)
glossary.ኮኑ: ኮነ — they became (3mp perfect, k-w-n) · 'so they were' in a simile (ከማሁ ኮኑ 'thus they were')
glossary.ኮና: ኮነ — they were (3fp perfect, agreeing with the feminine እደው 'hands')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ኵላ: ኵሉ — all, the whole (variant form ኵላ, accusative)
glossary.ወለሰይጣን: ሰይጣን — and Satan, marked as object (ወ- + ለ- + proper name)
glossary.ወለደቂቁ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'to' marking the object + plural ደቂቅ + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.ወሣልስት: ሣልስ — and third (ወ- + ordinal, fem. ሣልስት, agreeing with ሌሊት)
glossary.ወረሰያ: ረሰየ — and he made it (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ 'it', 3fs)
glossary.ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወቀተለ: ቀተለ — and he killed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, q-t-l)
glossary.ወቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — and first, at first (ወ- + adjective used adverbially)
glossary.ወበመስቀሉ: መስቀል — and by his cross (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ሁ 'his')
glossary.ወበትረ: በትር — and rod of (ወ- + noun, construct) · and staff (ወ- + noun, accusative; ሕልቀተ ወበትረ 'ring and staff')
glossary.ወበትንሣኤሁ: ትንሣኤ — and by his resurrection (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.ወበከ: ከመ — and as, first part of ወበከመ (ወ- + በ- + ከ-), printed split as ወበከ ፡ መ (source slip)
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወበፀጋሙ: ፀጋም — and at his left hand (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted -ሙ)
glossary.ወባዕድኒ: ባዕድ — and another also, furthermore (ወ- + adjective/noun 'other' + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወተቀነወ: ተቀነወ — and he was nailed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, passive of ቀነወ)
glossary.ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወኀጥኡ: ኀጥአ — and they lacked, were without (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect; ኀጥአ 'miss, lack') (?)
glossary.ወንሕነኒ: ንሕነ — and we too (ወ- + 1cp pronoun + emphatic -ኒ)
glossary.ወአመኒ: አመ — and at the time when (ወ- + አመ + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወአሜሃ: አሜሃ — and then, at that time (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወአምጽአ: አምጽአ — and he brought (ወ- + 3ms perfect, caus., m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወአኀዝዎ: አኀዘ — and they held him (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወአውፅኦሙ: አውጽአ — and he sent them out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወጽአ + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወአዘዞ: አዘዘ — and he commanded him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወአዳመ: አዳም — and pleasing (?) (ወ- + adjective, accusative, parallel to ሠናየ; as in the known entry for አዳም) (?)
glossary.ወአፅግዑ: አፅግዐ — and they set down, rested (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect of a causative verb; the verb is uncertain, perhaps a slip for አጽንዐ 'prop, support') (?)
glossary.ወእገሪሁ: እግር — and his foot (feet) (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', form እገሪ-; singular used collectively, so l 'foot', i 'feet')
glossary.ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
glossary.ወካ: ካዕበ — and again, first part of ወካዕበ, printed split as ወካ ፡ ዕበ (source slip)
glossary.ወክርስቲያን: ክርስቲያን — and Christians (ወ- + noun, plural sense)
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወወሀበነ: ወሀበ — and he gave us (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ነ 'us', 1cp)
glossary.ወወልጦተ: ወልጦት — and changing, alteration (ወ- + verbal noun, accusative; w-l-ṭ)
glossary.ወዕተቦ: ዐተበ — and seal it, mark it! (ወ- + imperative 2ms + -ኦ 'it')
glossary.ወዘነደቁ: ነደቀ — and what they set up (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — and without (ወ- + preposition) · 'and before' + subjunctive (ወዘእንበለ ታጥብዎ 'and before she could nurse him')
glossary.ወይመው: ሞአ — and they conquer, first part of ወይመውእዎሙ, printed split as ይመው ፡ እዎሙ (source slip)
glossary.ወይመውእዎሙ: ሞአ — and they conquer them (ወ- + 3mp imperfect ይመውኡ + -ዎሙ 'them', 3mp)
glossary.ወይሰድድዎሙ: ሰደደ — and they pursue them, drive them off (ወ- + 3mp imperfect + -ዎሙ 'them')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወደቂቁ: ደቂቅ — and his children, sons (ወ- + noun + -u 'his')
glossary.ወደይ: ወደየ — and put! (imperative 2ms, G, w-d-y 'place, put')
glossary.ወጸልመ: ጸልመ — and it was darkened (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወፅኡ: ወፅአ — they went out (3mp perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወፅግመ: ፅግም — and left side (ወ- + noun, adverbial accusative 'to the left')
glossary.ወ፫: ፫ — and 3, spoken ወሠለስ (wä-śäläs) (?) 'and three' before the feminine ሌሊት (numeral, ወ- + digit)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውስቴቱ: ውስተ — within it, in it (preposition ውስተ, stem ውስቴ- + 3ms suffix -ቱ)
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ዐማሌቅ: ዐማሌቅ — Amalek (proper name, people and ancestor)
glossary.ዐማሌቅሰ: ዐማሌቅ — Amalek, as for Amalek (proper name + enclitic -ሰ 'as for, but')
glossary.ዐማልቅ: ዐማሌቅ — Amalek (proper name; spelled without ሌ as printed, source slip)
glossary.ዐርገ: ዐርገ — he went up (3ms perfect, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.ዓማሌቅ: ዓማሌቅ — Amalek (proper name, people and ancestor)
glossary.ዕርበተ: ዕርበት — setting (of the sun) (verbal noun, construct state, from ዐረበ)
glossary.ዕበ: ካዕበ — [ʿəbä], the last part of ወካዕበ 'and again', printed split (source slip)
glossary.ዘማሰነ: ማሰነ — what was spoiled, perished (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect; sense from the root)
glossary.ዘበእንቲአሁ: በእንተ — for whose sake (ዘ- 'who, whose' + በእንተ with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
glossary.ዘበጠ: ዘበጠ — he struck (3ms perfect, G, z-b-ṭ)
glossary.ዘተመውኡ: ተሞአ — who were conquered (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, passive ተ-stem of ሞአ)
glossary.ዘነደቁ: ነደቀ — which/what they set up (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect)
glossary.ዘነፍሐ: ነፍሐ — which he breathed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ዘነፍስ: ነፍስ — that of soul, i.e. living (?) (ዘ- 'of' + noun; the pair with ይብስት 'dry' is my reading) (?)
glossary.ዘኒ: ዘ — moreover, also (?) (ዘ + enclitic -ኒ; ስምዑ ዘኒ ፍካሬ 'hear, moreover, the interpretation'; ዘኒ ፍካሬሁ ስምዑ 'also its interpretation, hear'; precise force uncertain) (?) · read here as 'this too', parallel to ዝኒ (ዘኒ ገሃደ አርአየ 'this too he showed openly')
glossary.ዘየማን: የማን — of the right, at the right (ዘ- + noun)
glossary.ዘያርመሰምስ: አርመሰመሰ — which one gropes in, which gropes (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect ያርመሰምስ of a four-letter verb of the አንጐርጐረ type, r-m-s-m-s; said of the darkness; sense uncertain, lemma by analogy) (?)
glossary.ዘይሰትዩ: ሰትየ — what they might drink (?) (ዘ- relative + 3mp imperfect/jussive) (?)
glossary.ዘፀጋም: ፀጋም — of the left, at the left (ዘ- + noun)
glossary.የዐፅቦ: ዐጽበ — it wearies him (?) (3ms imperfect + -ኦ 'him'; lemma spelled ዐጽበ as in የዐጽበኒ elsewhere in the book; sense from the context) (?)
glossary.ያሌዕል: አልዐለ — he raises, lifts up (?) (3ms imperfect ያሌዕል, causative of ልዕለ; lemma by the expected pattern, form as printed) (?)
glossary.ያርኢ: አርአየ — he shows (3ms imperfect, a-stem causative of ርእየ 'see')
glossary.ይምነ: የማን — right, right side (noun, here adverbial 'to the right'; spelled ይምነ)
glossary.ይሤኒ: ሠነየ — he is handsome, beautiful (3ms imperfect, G) · 'becomes beautiful', intransitive (በትእምርተ መስቀል ይሤኒ ኵሉ 'by the sign of the cross all becomes beautiful')
glossary.ይረክቡ: ረከበ — they find (3mp imperfect, subjunctive after እስከ; the subject is unclear) (?)
glossary.ይሰቀል: ተሰቅለ — he is crucified, is to be crucified (3ms imperfect, passive of ሰቀለ)
glossary.ይሰደዲ: ሰደደ — that he might drive out (3ms jussive, as printed; the regular jussive would be ይሰድድ, so the form may be corrupt or a variant) (?)
glossary.ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ይብስተ: የብስ — dry, dryness (?) (noun/adjective, accusative, printed ይብስተ; predicate of ኮነት) (?)
glossary.ይብስት: የብስ — dry (?) (noun/adjective 'dry, dry land'; feminine ይብስት, printed with ይ for የ; in እንዘ ይብስት 'while dry') (?)
glossary.ይተረጐም: ተርጐመ — it is interpreted (3ms imperfect ይተረጐም, passive/reflexive ተ-stem)
glossary.ይትመውኡ: ተሞአ — they are conquered (3mp imperfect, passive ተ-stem of ሞአ)
glossary.ይትዌጽዑ: ተዌጽአ — they are routed, driven out (?) (3mp imperfect, passive stem of the ተዌሰከ type, probably of ወጽአ/አውጽአ; sense from the context) (?)
glossary.ይትዐተቡ: ተዐተበ — they are sealed, marked (3mp imperfect, passive/reflexive of ዐተበ)
glossary.ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n) · let it be (3ms jussive, here after ዘእንበለ 'except': ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ 'except it be that the tendril put forth blossom') (?)
glossary.ይወፅኡ: ወጽአ — they come out (3mp imperfect, G)
glossary.ይጸልዩ: ጸለየ — they pray, that they might pray (3mp jussive, after ከመ)
glossary.ይጸብኡ: ፀብአ — they fight (3mp imperfect; plural verb after the collective ዐማልቅ)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገሃደ: ገሃድ — openly, evident (adjective as adverbial accusative)
glossary.ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct) · Egypt as goal of a journey, accusative without a preposition (ርደተ አብርሃም ግብጽ 'descent of Abraham to Egypt') · the Egyptians (ርእይዎሙ ግብጽ 'the Egyptians saw them')
glossary.ጥዑመ: ጥዑም — sweet (adjective, accusative, before መባልዕተ) · predicate accusative after ኮነ (ይኩን ጥዑመ 'let it be sweet'; ማይ መሪር ይከውን ጥዑመ 'bitter water becomes sweet')
glossary.ፀብአ: ፀብእ — war, battle (noun, accusative) · also construct 'war of' (ፀብአ ሰይጣን 'the war of Satan') (?) · construct 'war of' (ፀብአ ዐማሌቅ 'the war of Amalek'; ፀብአ መሀይምናን 'the war of believers')
glossary.፫: ፫ — 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'three' (መጠነ ፫ እመት 'to the measure of three cubits'; ፫ ልብስ 'three garments'); spoken ሠለስ (śäläs) (?) before a feminine noun such as እመት, ሠለስቱ with a masculine · after a noun, 'third' (ወልድከ ፫ 'your third son'), the spoken ordinal ሣልስ (śalləs) (?)
